title: Database startup parameter snapshots
description: One row per selected run, database, and nondefault parameter. Values are plaintext from the primary startup snapshot; they are not live settings.

targets.expr: max by (experiment_id,run_id,database_name,parameter,display_value,value_status) (last_over_time(parkbench_openedge_db_parameter_snapshot_info{experiment_id=~"$experiment_id",run_id=~"$run_id",phase=~"$phase"}[$__range])) * on (experiment_id,run_id,database_name) group_left() max by (experiment_id,run_id,database_name) (last_over_time(parkbench_openedge_db_parameter_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{experiment_id=~"$experiment_id",run_id=~"$run_id",phase=~"$phase"}[$__range])) * 1000

title: Snapshot status and evidence gaps
description: empty means a complete _DbParams read found no nondefault values. partial and unavailable are evidence gaps. No status series means a pre-feature run or no samples in the selected time window.

title: Numeric startup parameter comparison
description: Finite numeric values for selected startup snapshots; text values remain in the main table.

options.content: **No nondefault startup parameters** applies only when the status table says `empty`. `partial` and `unavailable` indicate an evidence gap. If no status row appears, the run predates this capture or the selected time range has no sample; inspect saved run evidence. Unknown values are labeled `unknown` in the main table.
